_comment: Demo library for tools/demo/server.mjs. Films, images and videos are openly licensed or public domain; see docs/screenshots/CREDITS.md (generated by credits.mjs). media/videos/people/movies/shows are generated from Wikimedia Commons metadata.

collections.title: Blender Open Movies
collections.summary: Every short made in the open by the Blender Foundation and Blender Studio.

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.summary: A gentle giant of a rabbit enjoys a sunny morning in the meadow until three bullying rodents go one prank too far. Then he plans his revenge.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.summary: Old Proog guides young Emo through a vast, shifting machine that only he seems to understand, and the two see very different worlds in it.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Sintel
movies.summary: A lonely young woman nurses a wounded baby dragon back to health. When it is snatched away, she crosses snowfields, deserts and cities to find it again.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.summary: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of scientists stage a desperate experiment: replay one painful breakup in the hope of saving the world.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep called Franck meets Victor, a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Glass Half
movies.summary: Two amateur art critics argue loudly about every piece in a gallery, to the dismay of everyone around them, until they find one they can agree on.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Hero
movies.summary: A hand-drawn chase through a crumbling ruin, made to show off 2D animation inside a 3D world.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Spring
movies.summary: A shepherd girl and her dog face the ancient spirits of the mountain to keep the cycle of life turning.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Coffee Run
movies.summary: Fuelled by caffeine, a young woman runs through the bittersweet memories of a past relationship.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Sprite Fright
movies.summary: A group of rowdy teenagers trek into an isolated forest and meet some peaceful mushroom creatures. They turn out to be an unexpected force of nature.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Charge
movies.summary: In an energy-starved dystopia, an old man breaks into a battery factory and finds himself face to face with a deadly security droid.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Wing It!
movies.summary: An uptight engineer gets an unwelcome visit from an eager would-be pilot, and both end up launched into the sky in an out-of-control rocket.
movies.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.summary: Strangers barricade themselves in a remote farmhouse in Pennsylvania as the recently dead rise and close in around them.
movies.licenceNote: Public domain in the US: released in 1968 without a copyright notice.

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.summary: An estate agent travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the mysterious Count Orlok, who follows him home, and brings the plague with him.
movies.licenceNote: Public domain: published in 1922 (US); its director and writer died more than 70 years ago.

movies.title: The General
movies.summary: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, with his sweetheart on board, a Southern railway engineer gives chase alone.
movies.licenceNote: Public domain in the US: published in 1926, copyright expired.

movies.title: Charade
movies.summary: After her husband is murdered, a young widow in Paris is pursued by his old partners in crime, all after a fortune that has vanished, and by a charming stranger she can't quite trust.
movies.licenceNote: Public domain in the US: released in 1963 without a valid copyright notice.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.summary: A newspaper editor learns his ex-wife and star reporter is about to remarry and leave the business, and uses one last big story to win her back.
movies.licenceNote: Public domain in the US: the 1940 copyright was not renewed.

shows.title: Caminandes
shows.summary: Koro, a stubborn llama in Patagonia, will go to any length to reach the other side of the road, the greener grass or the last berry.

episodes.title: Llama Drama
episodes.summary: Koro wants to cross the road to the grass on the other side. The fence has other ideas.

episodes.title: Gran Dillama
episodes.summary: Koro tries to reach the grass beyond an electric fence, and meets a curious armadillo along the way.

episodes.title: Llamigos
episodes.summary: In the Patagonian winter, Koro fights a penguin called Oti for the last berry on the bush.

shows.licenceNote: Blender open movie, (CC) Blender Foundation | www.blender.org

shows.title: NASA Explorers
shows.summary: Short documentaries about the people behind NASA's science: who they are, what they study and why it matters.

episodes.title: We Are the Artemis Generation
episodes.summary: Meet the scientists and engineers getting ready for the first crewed landings on the Moon in more than fifty years.

episodes.title: Moon Rocks
episodes.summary: Using tiny samples brought back by the Apollo astronauts, NASA's rock detectives look into where the Moon came from.

episodes.title: Space School
episodes.summary: A geologist turned astronaut trains on the International Space Station for work on the Moon.

episodes.title: The South Pole
episodes.summary: Why the Moon's south pole, with its permanently shadowed craters, is where Artemis astronauts are headed.

shows.licenceNote: Public domain: a work of NASA, a US government agency (NASA media guidelines apply; no endorsement implied).

shows.title: NASA ScienceCasts
shows.summary: Short explainers from NASA Science about the night sky, the planets and life in orbit.

episodes.title: Handprints on Hubble
episodes.summary: As the Hubble Space Telescope turns 25, a look back at the astronauts who serviced it by hand.

episodes.title: Historic Vegetable Moment on the Space Station
episodes.summary: Astronauts eat lettuce grown in space, and learn something about farming far from Earth.

episodes.title: Amazing Moons
episodes.summary: The moons of the outer planets turned out to be stranger and more varied than anyone expected.

episodes.title: NASA's Next Great Space Telescope
episodes.summary: Assembly of the James Webb Space Telescope is under way.

episodes.title: A Supermoon Trilogy
episodes.summary: Three supermoons in a row light up the winter sky.

episodes.title: Lightning Across the Solar System
episodes.summary: Lightning flashes on other planets too, and it tells us about their atmospheres.
